# Raw

Untouched image files, exactly as downloaded, one per card component.

Nothing is recoloured, cropped or rescaled on the way in. If a file has to be
converted for Unity to read it — `.webp` to `.png` — that is the only change,
and the name stays the same, so it is always clear what came from where.

See the README one folder up for what belongs here and what has to be settled
before anything is committed.
